verdict.rationale: Khoj supports bringing your own model backends. Docs cover Ollama and LiteLLM, the GitHub README lists many online LLMs (gpt, claude, gemini, deepseek), and community users confirm chat runs on a user-supplied OpenAI key. The pack has no evidence of token-usage or cost tracking at all. Missing for 10: token usage visibility, cost tracking per model or per conversation, explicit docs on configuring provider API keys or subscriptions.
